payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 2 requires that 'an advisory gate ... carries no count', but no witness ever asserts `new_failures is None` for an advisory gate in a normal (non-aborted, non-drifted) suite. In `test_each_attempts_gate_results_carry_their_own_attempt_number`, `size` is advisory (tier is 'standard' by default, and `_advisory` only exempts `size` when elevated), and it is present in `latest.results`, yet `by1`/`by2` only check `types` and `lint`. Deleting the `result.gate not in latest.advisory_gates` clause at line 1891 makes every passing advisory gate emit a measured `0` instead of `None` -- a real regression against the stated criterion -- while all three witnesses (including the aborted/drifted one, where `counted` is already `None` for every gate regardless of this clause) stay green.
